title: Kissed Spanish Cheese Ceviche
description: A salty and shaggy solo dinner that turns Spanish cheese into a bright, tangy ceviche with malt vinegar and sous-vide. The dish is lacto-vegetarian friendly and perfect for a quick yet indulgent meal.
instructions: Place the shredded Manchego cheese into a vacuum bag with salt and pepper, seal it, and preheat the sous-vide water bath to 60 degrees Celsius.
Cook the sealed bag in the water bath for 45 minutes at 60 degrees Celsius.
Remove the bag, open it carefully, and let the cheese cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk together the malt vinegar, lemon juice, and olive oil until emulsified.
Add the chilled cheese to the bowl, and gently fold until coated with the vinaigrette.
Fold in the shredded lettuce, halved cherry tomatoes, thinly sliced onion, and chopped cilantro.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt or pepper if desired.
Transfer the mixture onto a plate and serve immediately as a bright, tangy Spanish cheese ceviche.
